DropdownMenu at the right edge: 16px from the edge, at most 22rem wide, card radius
Popover at the right edge: 16px from the edge, at most 22rem wide, card radius
a forty-row menu opened low fits the room and scrolls inside
the phone viewport: a long menu is the viewport less 1rem a side at most
adjacent hop: the indicator glides at its own size in one monotone leg
far hop: the indicator glides at its own size in one monotone leg
hover on an inactive tab changes its colour and nothing else
re-clicking the active tab on its centre moves nothing
re-clicking the active tab off its centre moves nothing
the indicator can be dragged to the next tab, and stays under the label it commits
a 8 px drag out and back, released on its start, leaves the next hop gliding
a 24 px drag out and back, released on its start, leaves the next hop gliding
a twelve-row list that fits the room shows whole
a short viewport bounds the list 16px from the edge and it scrolls inside
below 30rem the listbox is a bottom sheet at full width
sheet opened deep in the page is fixed and on screen (consumer layer)
sheet opened deep in the page is fixed and on screen (unlayered)
